name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code: trims long Bash, MCP and Read results in a tool.call hook, and/or replaces the session summary in a session.compact hook.

mode.title: Compaction mode
mode.description: tool: trim long tool results as they arrive (default). session: replace the built-in summary at compaction time and auto-compact. both: run both hooks.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a chunk of tool output is still needed; below it the chunk is omitted.

minChars.title: Minimum output size
minChars.description: Tool outputs shorter than this many characters are never touched.

chunkLines.title: Lines per chunk
chunkLines.description: Lines scored together; widened so one output never has more than maxChunks chunks.

maxChunks.title: Maximum chunks
maxChunks.description: Ceiling on chunks (and Jev questions) per tool output.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum share of characters a rewrite must save; otherwise the output passes through untouched.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the tool output sent to Jev.

compactRead.title: Compact Read results
compactRead.description: Also compact long Read results. Omitted lines become [...] placeholders so line numbers stay correct. Set false to disable.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Session mode: context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Session mode: number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Session mode: estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Session mode: characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
